content: वर {%a.%} [वृ-कर्मणि अप्] .²1 Best, excellent, most beautiful or precious, choicest, finest, royal, princely; with <ab>gen.</ab> or <ab>loc.</ab> or usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>; वदतां वरः <ls>R. 1. 59</ls>; वेदविदां वरेण <ls n="R.">5. 23</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 54</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 18</ls>; नृवरः, तरुवराः, सरिद्वरा <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Better than, preferable to; ग्रन्थिभ्यो धारिणो वराः <ls>Ms. 12. 103</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 352</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 The act of choosing, selecting. .²2 Choice, selection. .²3 A boon, blessing, favour (तपोभिरिष्यते यस्तु देवेभ्यः स वरो मतः); वरं वृ or याच् ‘to ask a boon’; प्रीतास्मि ते पुत्र वरं वृणीष्व <ls>R. 2. 63</ls>; भवल्लब्धवरोदीर्णः <ls>Ku. 2. 32</ls>; (for the distinction between वर and आशिस् see आशिस्). .²4 A gift, present, reward, recompense. .²5 A wish, desire in general. .²6 Solicitation, entreaty. .²7 Charity, alms. .²8 Surrounding, enclosing. .²9 Obstructing, checking. .²10 A bridegroom, husband; वरं वरयते कन्या; see under वधू (1) also. .²11 A suitor, wooer. .²12 A dowry. .²13 A son-in-law; ‘वरो जामातरि श्रेष्ठे’ इति विश्वः; रथाङ्गभर्त्रेऽभिनवं वराय <ls>Śi. 3. 36</ls>. .²14 A dissolute man, libertine. .²15 A sparrow. .²16 Bdellium. .{@-रम्@} Saffron; (for वरम् see separately).
